title: HERESY — THE CITY OF DIS
author: Arkham / True Form
content:
The heretics believed their own interpretation over the truth. They built systems around their misreading and called it wisdom.

I translated the Qliphoth texts myself. Every word, every seal, every binding. I understood them better than anyone alive — better than the Order, better than Vergil, certainly better than that demon's son.

And still the power rejected me. Still the Qliphoth chose Vergil's blood over my years of study. There is no justice in the Demon World. There is only inheritance.
